blueprints.description: Invoices for a finance team: a receivables overview, an invoice list, an invoice page with its lines and payments, the payments received and a due-date calendar.

screens.name: invoicing.overview
screens.title: Overview
screens.description: What is owed, what is overdue and what came in this month.

screens.name: invoicing.list
screens.title: Invoices
screens.description: Every invoice with what is owed and its status.

screens.name: invoicing.record
screens.title: Invoice
screens.description: One invoice: key facts, its lines, its payments and its activity.

screens.name: invoicing.payments
screens.title: Payments
screens.description: The payments received and the invoices they settled.

screens.name: invoicing.due
screens.title: Due dates
screens.description: The day each invoice falls due, on a calendar.

templates.name: InvoicingOverview
templates.description: Outstanding, overdue and collected this month, receivables by age, invoiced against collected and the invoices to chase.

templates.name: InvoicesList
templates.description: Every invoice with its customer, issue and due dates, amount and status, filtered by customer, status and date.

templates.name: InvoicePage
templates.description: One invoice: status, total, paid and balance due, its details, lines and payments, and its activity.

templates.name: PaymentsList
templates.description: The payments received with the invoice each settled, when and how, filtered by method and date.

templates.name: InvoicingDueDates
templates.description: The day each invoice falls due, on a month, a week or as an agenda, with the status told in words.

templates.name: InvoicingQuickCreateInvoice
templates.description: A short form that creates one invoice without leaving the page.

templates.name: InvoicingRecordPayment
templates.description: A short form that creates one payment without leaving the page.
